description: This file contains unit tests for the OCIContainer component, including event handling, container lifecycle operations, and RPC interface testing. It uses Google Test and Google Mock frameworks to simulate interactions and verify behaviors of container management functions.

classes.name: AsyncHandlerMock_OCIContainer
classes.description: Mock class for handling asynchronous container events, with methods for container started, stopped, failed, and state changed.

classes.description: Test fixture class for OCIContainer, setting up mocks, RPC interfaces, and containing test cases for container operations and event handling.
